about: Laura R. Feldman is an attorney providing legal services covering Employment Litigation: Plaintiff, Employment & Labor: Employee, Civil Rights and Employment & Labor: Employer.

Laura Feldman, who practices law in Chicago, Illinois, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2020 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at Northwestern University School of Law. She graduated in 2008. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 2008.
